ceo.notes: Identity is strongly confirmed by full name, patronymic, company, 2024 CEO role, education, and employer chain. The local 2024 annual report confirms CEO status but does not disclose a management biography. Education is confirmed for institution and years; specialties are supported by SIBUR/RT-Online/Realnoe Vremya, while exact diploma qualifications were not identified. No confirmed candidate/doctor degree, PhD, h-index, ORCID/Scopus/Google Scholar profile, or academic research employment was identified. One Tatar-inform profile appears to contain a typo saying first KSTU graduation was in 1988; this was rejected because the person was born in 1975 and better sources say 1998. One conference publication is included with a caution because the author line uses initials only, though affiliation and timing match the target person. ROUND 2 (2026-07-19, gap-filling per project instructions; this paragraph was recovered into this field on 2026-07-30 after being found dropped from the working file, see research_notes/KZOS/quality_pass_round1_20260730.md section 0): local KZOS filings (annual report, IFRS audit report) were re-checked first and confirmed to still contain no personal biography/education detail for Safin beyond what round 1 already used; the annual report's product description (page 6) was reused to support GICS classification. Targeted web research closed the two remaining null qualification fields: KSTU 1998 (specialty 170500, Machines and Apparatus of Chemical Production and Building-Material Enterprises) and KSTU 2000 (specialty 060800, Economics and Management at an Enterprise) were each matched to their Russian state educational standards (specialist/diplomirovanny spetsialist, 5-year full-time programmes), giving qualification inzhener and ekonomist-menedzher respectively and qualification_degree = Specialist degree for both; confidence is high because both specialty codes and program names match the CEO's recorded program_or_specialty text closely and the source documents are the official state standards themselves. Institution field normalized in both education entries from the raw string Kazanskiy gosudarstvenny tekhnologichesky universitet to the canonical form Kazanskiy natsionalny issledovatelsky tekhnologichesky universitet per university_names.json, where the raw string is already listed as an existing synonym; this is not a newly discovered institution for this ticker. GICS sector/industry_group/industry were added at company level (Materials / Materials / Chemicals, from the 2024 annual report's own product description) and to every professional_experience entry, classifying each organization by its own primary line of business: the 1992-1996 first employer (Nizhnekamsk plant of building and metal structures) as Industrials / Capital Goods / Building Products (prefabricated building/metal structures manufacturer, per TatFirms); Nizhnekamskneftekhim and all Kazanorgsintez entries as Materials / Materials / Chemicals (both are large integrated petrochemical producers; confirmed for Kazanorgsintez by its own 2024 annual report and for Nizhnekamskneftekhim by Wikipedia/registry sources). Two entries were deliberately left null/null/null rather than guessed: OOO Kompaniya Fundament (1996-1997, Moscow, head of sales) - a targeted search found no verifiable description of this specific small mid-1990s firm's line of business, and the generic name Fundament makes any match to present-day companies of the same name unreliable, so the three fields were left null rather than guessed; and AO SIBUR-RT (2023-present, CEO role) - its own primary registered OKVED activity is generic financial/holding services (rusprofile), while Wikipedia describes its real function as a shared corporate-services/holding center for SIBUR's Tatarstan petrochemical assets (owning stakes in Nizhnekamskneftekhim and Kazanorgsintez) rather than itself manufacturing or selling a GICS-classifiable product; classifying it by its subsidiaries' chemicals business is excluded by project rules, and no single GICS bucket reliably captures a holding/shared-services entity, so sector/industry_group/industry were left null with this reasoning recorded rather than guessed. State Council of the Republic of Tatarstan (2024-present, deputy mandate) was also left null/null/null because it is a government legislative body, not a company, and gics_taxonomy.json contains no public-sector/government category to assign without inventing one. No previously confirmed fact was deleted or overwritten in round 2; all round-2 changes were additions to previously null/missing fields.

validation_notes: Processed 1 person from KZOS CSV input. Checked 2 local KZOS documents: the 2024 annual report and 2024 disclosed consolidated financial statements. Completed 1 research round for the single person, with more than 25 substantive queries across local reports, official company/SIBUR pages, State Council profile, regional public/business biographies, patent databases, conference proceedings, education variants and namesake checks. Education was found for the person; no person remains without confirmed education. Weak or cautious sources: Realnoe Vremya/RT-Online/TatCenter were used for fine-grained early career support; the 2020 conference publication is initials-only and retained with an attribution caution. No confirmed academic degree, h-index, ORCID/Scopus/Google Scholar profile, or research employment was found. Conflict resolved: Tatar-inform's apparent 1988 graduation typo was rejected in favor of multiple sources giving 1998/2000. Namesakes excluded include Marat Safin, Dinara Safina, unrelated patent inventors with different patronymics, and unrelated academic profiles. Search is considered complete because all local documents were read first, official and independent sources confirm the 2024 CEO role and career chain, previous employers were checked, patent/publication/degree branches were searched separately, and later passes produced no new higher-quality biographical facts. ROUND 2 (2026-07-19, gap-filling; this paragraph was recovered into this field on 2026-07-30 after being found dropped from the working file -- see research_notes/KZOS/quality_pass_round1_20260730.md section 0): processed the single KZOS person (CEO Safin; tmt remains empty, MOEXBMI_2024.csv re-checked and confirms only one KZOS row exists). Local filings (MOEXBMI_Отчеты_2024/KZOS/) were re-checked first per project procedure before any web search; no new personal biography data was found there (as expected, board/management personal composition remains undisclosed under Government Resolution No. 1102), but the annual report's own product description (page 6) was reused as the primary basis for company-level GICS classification. Added company-level sector/industry_group/industry = Materials / Materials / Chemicals, copied verbatim from gics_taxonomy.json, based on Kazanorgsintez's own disclosed production (ethylene, polyethylene, polycarbonate, bisphenol A, phenol, acetone, ethylene glycol, ethanolamines) and its own description as a chemical-industry enterprise; reliability high (primary local 2024 filing). Added sector/industry_group/industry to all 10 professional_experience entries for the CEO, classifying each organization by its own primary line of business rather than any subsidiary's: Industrials / Capital Goods / Building Products for the 1992-1996 first employer (prefabricated building/metal structures manufacturer, TatFirms); Materials / Materials / Chemicals for both Nizhnekamskneftekhim entries and all four Kazanorgsintez entries (large integrated petrochemical producers, confirmed by the company's own 2024 annual report and by independent registry/encyclopedia sources for Nizhnekamskneftekhim); left null/null/null with an explicit justification for three entries where a defensible single-organization classification could not be supported without guessing: OOO Kompaniya Fundament (1996-1997, unverifiable small firm), AO SIBUR-RT (2023-present, own primary registered activity is generic holding/financial services rather than a producing business, and classifying it by its chemicals subsidiaries is excluded by project rules), and the State Council of the Republic of Tatarstan (2024-present, a government legislature, not a GICS-classifiable company). Added qualification_degree = Specialist degree to both education[] entries (degrees[] is empty, nothing to add there), and filled the previously null qualification field for both using the Russian state educational standards for specialty 170500 (qualification inzhener) and specialty 060800 (qualification ekonomist-menedzher); reliability high because both official state-standard documents match the CEO's recorded specialty names and years closely. Normalized the institution field in both education entries from Kazanskiy gosudarstvenny tekhnologichesky universitet to the canonical form used in university_names.json, Kazanskiy natsionalny issledovatelsky tekhnologichesky universitet; the raw string was already listed there as a synonym of that canonical entry, so this is a normalization, not a newly discovered institution. No previously confirmed fact (education, professional_experience, publications, patents, sources, board_sources) was deleted, renamed, or overwritten in round 2; every round-2 change was either an addition to a previously null field or a spelling normalization to the project's canonical institution name. Quality-pass round 1 (2026-07-30): fixed two education-entry desyncs where round 2's already-decided values had not actually been written to the JSON -- institution normalized to the canonical Казанский национальный исследовательский технологический университет for both entries (per university_names.json, already flagged as a synonym match in round 2 notes but not applied), and qualification filled as инженер / экономист-менеджер (per round 2's already-cited state educational standard sources, also not applied); enriched the combined 1997-2005 Nizhnekamskneftekhim entry's description with the granular per-stint chronology already documented in round 1 notes (six dated roles from repair mechanic through head of styrene polymerization shop); reviewed every GICS triple against gics_taxonomy.json and found none incorrect (all already-classified organizations match their real primary business; correctly-non-classifiable nulls for AO SIBUR-RT and the State Council, and the genuinely under-sourced null for ООО Компания фундамент, were left untouched); ran one bounded round of fresh queries each for ООО Компания фундамент's GICS classification and for an academic degree/h-index/ORCID/Scopus profile, both still unresolved after this attempt and logged in research_notes/KZOS/quality_pass_round1_20260730.md with the specific queries tried so a future pass does not repeat them.
